channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Firmus Faces Scrutiny Over Oliver Curtis's Past
item.description: Firmus is facing scrutiny regarding its association with Oliver Curtis, with questions raised about whether he deserves a "third chance" in the tech world. The coverage suggests a "Firmus problem" related to Curtis's past. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: TV Personality Admits Using Show Budget for Drugs
item.description: Freddy Brazier has admitted to using the budget allocated for the television show "Celebrity Race Across the World" to purchase drugs during filming. The incident occurred while he was participating in the program. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Willie Mullins fined, horse disqualified after failed drug test
item.description: Trainer Willie Mullins has been fined and his horse disqualified after a runner-up at the Cheltenham Festival failed a drug test for mepivacaine. Mullins was reportedly "visibly shocked" by the development. The horse was disqualified for… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Federal agents search Ilhan Omar's home in fraud investigation
item.description: Federal agents searched the Washington D.C. residence of U.S. Representative Ilhan Omar on Monday morning as part of a criminal fraud investigation. Sources familiar with the matter told the Associated Press that Homeland Security agents… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 2 · Right 2.

item.title: Minor allegedly sexually assaulted in Varanasi public toilet; suspect arrested
item.description: A 14-year-old girl was allegedly sexually assaulted in a public toilet in the Beniyabagh area of Varanasi. Police have arrested the accused, identified as Dulare Ansari. ACP Atul Anjan Tripathi stated that a chargesheet would be filed… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Woman Allegedly Killed Over Witchcraft Suspicion in Bihar
item.description: A 52-year-old woman was allegedly killed in Bihar on suspicion of practicing witchcraft. Following the incident, the victim's family protested outside the house of the accused. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Senior advocate Harish Salve has alleged that foreign funding and interference are behind some protests in India, suggesting a conspiracy to create instability. He stated that the Indian government should investigate these claims. The… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court weighs firecracker use against health and religious concerns
item.description: The Supreme Court is deliberating on the use of firecrackers, seeking a balance between religious sentiments and public health concerns, particularly regarding pollution. The court emphasized the necessity of community awareness to promote… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Two Pakistan Army pilots killed in training aircraft crash
item.description: A Pakistan Army training aircraft crashed near Quetta, resulting in the deaths of two pilots. The crash was reportedly due to a technical fault. Following the incident, Pakistan's President and Prime Minister expressed their condolences. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 2.

item.title: SFI Alleges Women Activists Detained After Sunset in Delhi
item.description: The Students' Federation of India (SFI) has alleged that 22 of its women activists were manhandled and detained after sunset during a Tiranga rally in Delhi. According to the SFI, the activists were carried away in a bus that did not have… Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court Clarifies Stance on New Form 6 in Bihar SIR Case
item.description: The Supreme Court has clarified its position on the new Form 6, stating that it has neither approved nor disapproved of the changes. These alterations, introduced in July, require applicants to provide ancestry details or linkage to… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 11 · Right 2.

item.title: Melbourne Man Denies Links to Suspected Hijacker
item.description: A Melbourne man, identified as Samir Mohtadi and also known as Abu Hamza, who leads an Islamic centre allegedly linked to the accused Flydubai hijacker, has released a video. In the video, Mohtadi refers to Islamic texts on the virtues of… Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Three drug peddlers arrested in Jammu, pistols and narcotics seized
item.description: Three individuals identified as drug peddlers were arrested in Jammu, and police seized two pistols and a quantity of narcotics. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Christa Pike returns to prison after botched execution and hospital stay
item.description: Christa Pike, who survived a botched execution attempt, has been discharged from the hospital and returned to a Tennessee prison. She was reportedly "angry" over the execution not being completed and had been "ready to die." Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Australian Engineer Robert Pether Allowed to Leave Iraq
item.description: Australian engineer Robert Pether has been permitted to leave Iraq after being jailed in 2021. The Australian foreign minister welcomed the Iraqi government's decision to allow his departure from Baghdad. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Delhi Police Files FIR Against Congress MP Bimol Akoijam for Sexual Harassment
item.description: The Delhi Police have registered a First Information Report (FIR) naming Congress Member of Parliament Bimol Akoijam in connection with sexual harassment allegations. The FIR was filed following a complaint against the MP, who is also… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Manchester City Faces Premier League Scrutiny
item.description: Manchester City is under scrutiny from the Premier League, with one report detailing a ruling that has impacted the league. Despite this, the team, managed by Enzo Maresca, has achieved six consecutive wins, equalling a Premier League… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 7 · Right 0.

item.title: Protests in Delhi: Allegations of Police Brutality and Calls for Due Process
item.description: During protests in Delhi, the Students' Federation of India (SFI) has alleged police brutality and sexual harassment. Concurrently, opposition parties and the Centre for Public Interest Litigation (CJP) have vowed to continue protests… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: The U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) is investigating whether the halt in White House television pool coverage violated antitrust laws. The probe specifically examines the response of major TV networks to a White House ban on CNN's… Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.title: Police pursuit ends in crash, one hospitalized
item.description: A police pursuit in Perth's southern suburbs concluded with a serious crash, resulting in one elderly man being rushed to the hospital. Another individual is in custody following the incident. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: US inmate suffers 'absolute torture' in botched execution
item.description: An American female inmate, identified as facing 'absolute torture', was in critical condition following a botched execution. The incident has led to renewed questioning of the death penalty, with Pope Francis reportedly criticizing the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Bhagat Singh Photo in Voter Roll Sparks Row in Ludhiana
item.description: A photograph of Bhagat Singh appeared on a voter roll in Ludhiana, triggering a controversy. Officials stated that the inclusion of the photograph was an error and has since been corrected. The incident occurred amid broader scrutiny of… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: The Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) has postponed the 72nd Combined Competitive Preliminary Examination, originally scheduled for October 25, 2026. The commission cited unavoidable reasons for the postponement and stated that new… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Harvard Affiliates Condemn Delhi Police Action; UN Raises Concern
item.description: Harvard affiliates have expressed solidarity with senior advocate Shadan Farasat and condemned the Delhi Police's actions. The United Nations has also raised concerns regarding the police action. The specific nature of the police action… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: Communist Party of India (CPI) Member of Parliament (MP) Sandosh Kumar has written to Union Home Minister Amit Shah alleging harassment and unlawful confinement of journalists. The journalists were reportedly covering protests against the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: NIA attaches Srinagar property linked to LeT terrorist conspiracy
item.description: The National Investigation Agency (NIA) on Monday attached a residential property in Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir. The property is linked to a cross-border terrorist conspiracy case involving the Lashkar-e-Taiba (LeT) outfit and was… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: Youth Congress and CPI(M) activists clash in Kerala; cases registered
item.description: Following college union elections at the College of Engineering, Adoor, in Kerala, clashes erupted between youth activists of the Congress and CPI(M) parties. Police have registered three cases against activists from the Kerala Students… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Noida Schools Receive Bomb Threats, Investigations Underway
item.description: Multiple schools in Noida, including APJ, Step By Step, DPS GBN, JP, and Amity, received bomb threats, causing panic. Police and dog squads responded to the locations. Investigations into the calls, suspected to be hoaxes, have been… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Goa Nightclub Fire: High Court Orders Owners to Pay Victims' Families
item.description: The Bombay High Court has ordered the owners of a Goa nightclub, identified as the Luthra brothers, to deposit Rs 20 lakh each as interim aid for the families of victims of a recent fire incident. The court's directive comes in response to… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee released after claiming he was kidnapped
item.description: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee was detained by police and subsequently released; Rathee said he was kidnapped rather than legally detained and asserted that he did not sign any bond or undertaking, while police released him under unspecified… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.title: Netanyahu seeks probe into whistleblowers in Gaza war documentary
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has called for an investigation into whistleblowers who appeared in a documentary about the Gaza war. The documentary is reportedly titled 'NAZA'. The coverage does not specify the nature of the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court Restrains CBI Action Against Punjab CM Aide
item.description: The Supreme Court has ordered that no coercive action be taken against Rajbir Singh Ghuman, an Officer on Special Duty (OSD) linked to the Punjab government and Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann, in a corruption case being investigated by the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 7 · Right 0.

item.title: Former MLA Atar Singh Bhadana killed in attack at crusher plant
item.description: Former MLA Atar Singh Bhadana was killed in an attack at a crusher plant in Bharatpur, Rajasthan. Reports indicate that 70-80 people attacked the plant. The incident is reportedly linked to a dispute over a mining lease with villagers. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 2.

item.title: Kostya Manenkov's Death and Investigation
item.description: Kostya Manenkov, a Russian national, was found dead in his hotel room in Goa. The cause of death is under investigation. Preliminary reports suggest no foul play, but authorities are awaiting a post-mortem examination. Manenkov was… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: Amritsar Police Commissioner's Office Receives Bomb Threat
item.description: The office of the Amritsar Police Commissioner received a bomb threat via email, causing a stir and prompting a search operation. The entire premises were evacuated in haste. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: NIA Seizes Srinagar Property Used to Harbor Pakistani Terrorists
item.description: The National Investigation Agency (NIA) has seized a property in Srinagar that was allegedly used to provide shelter to Pakistani terrorists. The property belongs to Ghulam Mohammad Mir, also known as 'Mama Gus'. Investigations suggest… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Noida Schools Receive Bomb Threats, Security Increased
item.description: Multiple schools in Noida and Greater Noida received bomb threat emails, prompting immediate security checks and heightened vigilance. Authorities investigated the threats, and initial reports indicated that nothing suspicious was found. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Calcutta High Court directs CPI(M) to set up bookstalls during Kali Puja
item.description: The Calcutta High Court has directed the Communist Party of India (Marxist) to set up bookstalls during the Kali Puja festival. This directive comes after the party was reportedly denied permission to set up stalls during the Durga Puja… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: On October 10, 2026 a video showing a severed head among heavily armed militants circulated online; the headless body of Ajinbou R was taken for post-mortem after a militant attack in Manipur, and a Naga organization issued a 48-hour… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 2 · Right 2.

item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump has stated he will decide whether to livestream the execution of Nidal Hasan, the Fort Hood shooter. Hasan was convicted of killing 13 people and wounding 32 others in a 2009 shooting at Fort Hood, Texas. The… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 6 · Right 0.
